title: India’s maritime past lies submerged. Archaeology can bring it back
description: From Mesopotamian archives recording Indian trading communities to the maritime networks of the Indus-Saraswati and the Coromandel, the Indian Ocean was the true superhighway of the ancient world.

title: Excavations near ancient Turkish port may have found Alexander the Great’s soldiers tombs - report
description: According to AA, an initial survey of the necropolis identified at least 30 rock-cut tombs and chest-type graves scattered across the site. As of now, only 10 have been fully uncovered.

title: Ancient Greek elegy dedicated to judge found in ancient Egyptian tomb sealed with protection spells
description: Its 19-lines of ancient Greek text is written in red ink, dedicated to a person named "Pesikhtis," who, according to preliminary study, may have held the position of judge.

title: Was This Cave an Ancient Lab for Preserving Human Bodies?
description: A series of remarkably well-preserved human remains in a remote cave in Scotland has archaeologists grappling with a staggering question: were these bodies brought here during the Bronze Age to be mummified?
